records.source: FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine advisory
records.recalling_firm: Go Raw LLC dba Steve's Real Food
records.product_description: Eight FDA-tested lots of Quest Cat Food frozen and freeze-dried products
records.reason: Extremely low or no thiamine (Vitamin B1) in FDA-tested lots
records.status_label: FDA advisory — not all advised lots were recalled by the firm at publication
best_by: See FDA advisory for lot-specific dates
records.consumer_action: Check the FDA advisory for the exact lot. FDA recommends consulting a veterinarian about whether to continue feeding affected products.
records.notes: This is an FDA safety advisory, not a statement that all Quest products were recalled.
